Chapter 1129: 1 Fierce Sun Capital (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1129: Chapter 1 Fierce Sun Capital (Seeking Subscription)_2

But generations of emperors of the Ancient Country were reluctant to bestow it, preferring it to remain vacant rather than grant it away.

After all, it’s extremely difficult for a normal king to completely perish and fall; once bestowed, it would be hard for the Fierce Sun Ancient Country to reclaim it.

“Alright, this is His Majesty’s decision, not something you can discuss.” The leading woman in green swept a glance at the figures conversing, speaking calmly.

“Yes.”

The figures immediately fell silent.

At this moment.

Not far away, a massive space-time transference formation began emitting subtle space-time fluctuations, forming a space-time passage stretching from a distant place to here.

“It’s coming.”

The dozens of waiting figures immediately perked up.

They had been ordered to wait here for this moment, to welcome the Great Lord Galaxy.

Whoosh!

The space-time passage took shape, and several figures emerged from it.

At the forefront were a red-bearded old man and a young man.

“King Chibao and… the Great Lord Galaxy?”

The waiting figures immediately recognized King Chibao, and the young man standing alongside him should be the Great Lord Galaxy.

“The aura of the Great Lord Galaxy… I’ve never sensed it before; could it be from the core royal family of an unimaginably ancient period?”

“Uncertain.”

The dozens of figures each had different thoughts, and they immediately followed the woman in green to meet them.

…

Lin Yuan and King Chibao traveled via the space-time passage from the distant Qingfen Domain to arrive at this capital of the Fierce Sun Country.

“Crossing such a vast distance in ten breaths, even if space-time comprehension reaches the peak of the Ninth Realm, it’s impossible.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He left an avatar in Qingfen City, able to roughly sense the distance from his original form.

“And this capital of the Fierce Sun Country…” Lin Yuan observed his surroundings, faintly feeling an inexplicable pressure.

The entire capital of the Fierce Sun Country seemed like an unprecedented secret treasure, capable of suppressing ordinary Heavenly Venerate level experts with slight operation.

Buzz buzz buzz.

An inexplicable fluctuation swept silently over.

“Don’t overthink it, this is the sensing formation of the capital, to prevent experts from other ancient countries from infiltrating.” King Chibao explained through sound transmission beside him.

Lin Yuan nodded in acknowledgment.

The capital is the most prosperous and core place of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, as well as the most important location, requiring profound inspections for any expert entering the capital.

“So, I have passed?” Lin Yuan asked.

“Naturally.” King Chibao laughed.

The abundant Fierce Sun aura within Lin Yuan directly precludes the possibility of experts from other ancient countries.

The sensing formation of the capital, while ‘routine,’ applies not only to Lin Yuan but also includes King Chibao within its range.

After exiting the space-time passage, Lin Yuan saw dozens of figures walking towards them.

“Greetings to the Great Lord Galaxy…” The woman in green leading them bowed respectfully, and the dozens of figures behind her followed suit.

They did not know Lin Yuan’s real name or core royal title, so they could only use the currently known ‘Great Lord Galaxy’ to address him.

King Chibao, seeing this scene, smiled and looked at Lin Yuan, saying, “These people were sent by His Majesty to greet you.”

“His Majesty?” Lin Yuan nodded.

The ‘His Majesty’ here refers naturally to the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, also the strongest existence in the entire Fierce Sun Ancient Country in terms of combat power.

Of course, the emperor’s strength relies on external aid.

“His Majesty holds you in high regard.” King Chibao said, “Come, I’ll take you to your Mansion.”

After King Chibao spoke, the woman in green and the others stepped forward, leading Lin Yuan and King Chibao onto a warship.

Within the capital of the Fierce Sun Country, void traveling is forbidden, even to a Heavenly Venerate.

To reach a certain place, one must either fly honestly or use flying treasures such as warships.

The latter requires application to the ancient country, and operating a warship in the capital is usually a symbol of status.

Whoosh!

The warship soared into the sky, heading beyond the space-time transference area.

At this moment, numerous strong individuals, entering and exiting the space-time transference area, noticed the warship emerging from the depth of the area.

“That warship… is it a royal warship?”

“The Nine-Pattern Imperial Warship? Unless there is a personal order from His Majesty, no one can mobilize this warship.”

“Who exactly requires the Nine-Pattern Imperial Warship for a reception?”

Many experts gazed up in amazement as the warship departed.

The last time His Majesty deployed the Nine-Pattern Imperial Warship for a reception was after a grand victory against the Xuanyin Ancient Country in a large-scale war, when the commander-in-chief of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country returned to the capital to such treatment.

Xuanyin Ancient Country, like the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and Da Ling Ancient Country, is one of the six hegemonic ancient countries of this world.

But now?

For the past hundreds of thousands of years, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has not engaged in high-intensity warfare with the other five ancient countries, mostly involving local skirmishes. Even if victorious, one would return to the capital to receive rewards, but the deployment of the Nine-Pattern Imperial Warship for reception would be impossible.

…

On the warship, Lin Yuan overlooked the capital below.

“Hahaha, it’s been a long time since I was on this warship.” King Chibao was in a good mood, looking at Lin Yuan and saying, “It’s thanks to your honor, Galaxy.”

Very soon.

The warship stopped in front of a magnificent mansion.

Lin Yuan and King Chibao stepped out, followed by the woman in green and dozens of figures.

“Great Lord Galaxy, this is your Mansion.” The woman in green flipped her hand, producing a Token and respectfully handed it to Lin Yuan: “This is the Token for the Mansion, refining it will allow you to control the entire Mansion.”

Lin Yuan accepted the Token, refining it within a breath.

Through this Token, Lin Yuan could sense every detail of this mansion and also control everything within it, including the great formations enveloping the mansion.

The mansion’s formations are derived from those of the capital and can draw upon a trace of the capital’s formation power.

“Galaxy, give this mansion a name.” King Chibao said beside him.

“A name?” Lin Yuan pondered and said, “Let’s call it Galaxy Mansion.”

After all, his title is ‘Galaxy,’ so naming the mansion ‘Galaxy’ is normal and also very convenient.

As soon as Lin Yuan finished speaking, he controlled the Mansion Token to engrave the word ‘Galaxy’ atop the mansion.

“Galaxy Royal Mansion?” The dozens of figures behind mumbled to themselves; often, a mansion’s name corresponds to the title of a conferred king.

But Galaxy?

They originally thought ‘Galaxy’ was an alias, but now Lin Yuan using it as the mansion’s name clearly meant he had taken ‘Galaxy’ as his official title.

“That’s fine.”

King Chibao nodded.

The royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country usually includes ‘Chi’ in their official titles, such as King Chibao, Red Pine King, and King Chijue.

But it’s not absolute.

It mainly depends on the thoughts of the conferred king themselves.

“This mansion is now your abode, Galaxy. I wonder if I can have a look inside.” King Chibao smiled and said: “This is a genuine sacred place for cultivation, right beside the sun vein of the capital, yet His Majesty never had the heart to grant it to someone…

“Please enter.” Lin Yuan immediately controlled the Token to open the entrance of the mansion.

“Such intense Fierce Sun Origin Source…” Entering the mansion, Lin Yuan immediately felt the scorching aura filling the space.

Under this aura’s coverage, Lin Yuan felt extremely comfortable, as if soaking in a hot spring, with his internal Fierce Sun bloodline circulating more smoothly.

“How is it?” King Chibao asked, watching Lin Yuan with a smile.

His mansion, although not filled with such Fierce Sun Origin Source, was not considered inferior. It was Lin Yuan’s first encounter with such a cultivation environment.

“Very good.”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed it, saying solemnly.

Cultivating in such an environment, Lin Yuan’s efficiency in enlightenment would absolutely be surprisingly high.

Especially in aspects related to the sun and Fierce Sun, his progress might improve by leaps and bounds.

“Hahaha, then it’s all right.” King Chibao smiled brightly.

“Tomorrow, His Majesty will meet with you, so just settle in for today.” King Chibao said.

“Mm.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Just then——

King Chibao seemed to receive some information, immediately looking at Lin Yuan and saying: “Galaxy, the final merits of the war between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain have been determined.”
